title: Arrest without warrant is BNSS s

content.overview: Arrest without warrant is BNSS s. 35 (old CrPC 41, with the 41A notice folded in). Arrest is an exception, not the default, for offences punishable up to seven years. Handcuffing of specified serious offenders is s. 43(3).
